notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. The CBA (July 1, 2014 to June 30, 2018) and the 2017-2018 University Manual are both in force on that date. CBA Art. IV 4.1: where the Manual conflicts with the Agreement, the Agreement takes precedence; Manual ch. 7 notes that portions may have been superseded by collective bargaining agreements.

Bargaining unit (CBA Art. I): full-time and continuing part-time teaching and research faculty in the professorial ranks, librarians, clinical faculty and chairs; tenure-stream faculty are all in the unit, so CBA provisions are coded main_campus_tenure_stream.

Superseded Manual provision not coded: Manual 7.63.10-15 (sick leave granted by service: up to one month at full pay for two years or less, plus a half month per further year to 12 months; leave for incapacity beyond it at the President's discretion) conflicts with the CBA 21.3 accrual system (15 working days a year to 120); by CBA Art. IV 4.1 the Agreement governs. Flagged on c2 as a rule gap.

Chain, birth parent: paid parental leave 6 weeks (c1) -> own sick leave balance for medical reasons (c2) -> sick-leave advance 70 hours (c3, discretionary) -> sick leave bank up to 60 days (c4, discretionary); or, once sick leave is used, short-term leave without pay for illness (c5) -> leave without pay for illness up to one year (c6, discretionary), or disability insurance (c7, no length).
Chain, non-birth parent: paid parental leave 6 weeks (c1) -> own sick leave balance for illness in the immediate family (c2) -> sick-leave advance (c3, discretionary).
No statute is named for any leave: FMLA and the Rhode Island leave and insurance acts (RIPFMLA, TDI, TCI) appear in neither source; the statutory floor (U7) is filled from statutory_baseline.csv.

21.6 B defines family leave for the serious illness of a family member (physician certification of probable duration); the article grants no separate family-care leave with its own length beyond 21.6.2 (c9) and the sick leave definition (c2).
21.6.4 'Part-time faculty shall be eligible for maternity benefits' extends the parental leave (c1) to part-time unit faculty; it names no separate maternity benefit.

Not components (cannot be used for a birth or are not leave): sabbatical (21.1; Manual 7.61-7.62), graduate study leave (21.2; 7.60.16), bereavement leave (21.7), military and military training leave (21.12-21.13), annual vacation for calendar-year faculty (21.10; 7.65), annual review postponement for illness or LWOP (15.4), health benefit continuation rules during leave (14.1.5 note, 21.6.2).

Cross-references not saved: University Manual Appendix G policies listed by title only - Sick Leave #82-6, Advance Sick Leave #83-12, Breastfeeding and Lactation Support #08-1, Personal Leave Days #83-10, Vacation (Annual Leave) #82-7, Fringe Benefit Eligibility #82-8, Handicapped Employees, Reasonable Accommodations for #91-1, Life-Threatening Illnesses #89-1, Leave of Absence Without Pay for Classified Employees #82-12; CBA: State ERS or TIAA Group Insurance Policy (14.3), the university's normal rules for leaves of absence without pay (7.5), the non-classified accrued leave system (21.3), the supplemental insurance plans (MOA #11). Breastfeeding and Lactation Support #08-1 could hold a pregnancy-related accommodation (C9) but only its title is saved.
